name.description: Display name, e.g. Test or Live. Must be unique.

protocol.description: sftp (recommended), ftps (TLS) or ftp (UNENCRYPTED, avoid on untrusted networks).

privateKeyPath.description: SFTP: path to a private key, e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519. The key's passphrase goes into the password field of the server form. Supports ${env:NAME}.

useAgent.description: SFTP: authenticate with the running SSH agent (no password needed).

localPath.description: Local folder relative to the workspace root, e.g. ".". Supports ${env:NAME}.

remotePath.description: Remote root folder the local folder maps to, e.g. /var/www/html. Supports ${env:NAME}.

exclude.description: Exclude patterns: ".git" and "*.log" match names at any depth; patterns with a slash such as "cache/**" or "/uploads" match the path from the compared root.

useGitignore.description: Also exclude everything from the .gitignore in the local folder (negations with ! are not supported).

ignoreLineEndings.description: Treat files that differ only in line endings (CRLF vs LF) as equal when comparing (text files up to 5 MB).

uploadOnSave.description: Upload a file to this server whenever it is saved.

backupBeforeOverwrite.description: Copy files that are overwritten or deleted by a transfer to .vscode/remote-host-backup/<server>/<timestamp>/ first.

allowSelfSigned.description: FTPS only: accept self-signed or invalid certificates. Insecure, only for servers you trust.

timeOffsetMinutes.description: FTP servers without timezone info: minutes added to remote timestamps.
